name: Birder Fiona

intro.text: You walked straight through a corncrake's patch and it's in a huff. It'll be calling all night to tell the others. I'd like a word. And then a battle.

after: The chough is a red-billed crow that likes machair and sea cliffs. A chough on the machair is lucky. Seeing a corncrake is luckier. I've seen four in thirty years.
